understanding.summary: My Drone (dronedream.my-drone.v1) is a small quadcopter-class UAV with 2.125 kg dry mass and 40 g pickup payload capacity. It operates in base_link_frd coordinate frame with FRD body axes. Maximum takeoff mass is 2.165 kg, leaving 40 g total payload margin. Flight envelope: 1.2 m/s max speed, 0.8 m/s² max acceleration. Range is 413 m including 30% battery reserve; do not deduct reserve again. Body dimensions: 0.43 m height, 0.38 m radius, with collision center offset 0.228 m above model origin in Z. Sensor suite includes IMU, magnetometer, barometer, GPS, odometry, and OAK-D Lite depth camera for visual-inertial navigation and obstacle sensing. No geometry summary available; runtime clearance checks required.

items.explanation: Body height 0.43 m defines the vertical extent of the vehicle body for clearance and envelope planning.
Body radius 0.38 m defines the horizontal circular cross-section for obstacle clearance and corridor width checks.
collision_center_offset_model_m belongs to the model geometry convention. The geometry adapter applies it to the collision envelope; do not reinterpret model geometry axes as FRD flight-control axes.

The vehicle contract declares base_link_frd, with forward-right-down body axes. State estimates, sensors, maps and command interfaces may use other declared frames; explicit transforms remain required.
Configured unloaded vehicle mass is 2.125 kg; used in dynamics and takeoff mass budgeting. Battery inclusion status is as-configured by this product, not separately specified.
Maximum acceleration 0.8 m/s² limits commanded translational acceleration in all axes; trajectory planners must respect this bound.
Maximum pickup payload is 40 g; this is the cargo capacity for package retrieval missions, separate from the vehicle's own equipment.
Maximum speed 1.2 m/s bounds commanded translational velocity; planners must enforce this in all flight regimes.
Maximum takeoff mass 2.165 kg is the hard limit at liftoff; with 2.125 kg dry mass, total payload including pickup must not exceed 40 g.
Qualified range 413 m already includes the 30% battery reserve; mission range budgets must not deduct this reserve a second time.
30% reserve is embedded in qualified_range_m; this margin is for safety return and is not available for mission extension.

IMU, magnetometer, barometer, GPS, odometry, and OAK-D Lite depth camera provide state estimation, altitude, global position, visual odometry, and depth-based obstacle detection; sensor transforms are separate from the base_link_frd vehicle frame contract.

limitations: No 3D geometry summary available; runtime must verify all spatial clearances.
40 g payload limit strictly bounds package mass; planners must verify pickup item weight.
1.2 m/s speed and 0.8 m/s² acceleration limits constrain mission timing and maneuvering.
413 m range includes reserve; actual usable one-way distance depends on route geometry and wind, not to be extended by reinterpreting reserve.
OAK-D Lite depth sensing range and field of view not specified; obstacle detection limits require runtime confirmation.
No battery state, current location, or moving obstacle data in static asset; all require runtime sensing.

changes: Separated model geometry from FRD control frame
Removed claim that every command and state interface uses FRD
